name: What should I do immediately after discovering a sink leak?

mainEntity.name: What should I do immediately after discovering a sink leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: Upon discovering a sink leak, the first step is to turn off the water supply to the sink, usually by rotating the shut-off valves located directly under the sink. If no local shut-off is available, turn off the main water supply to your home. Next, disconnect any electrical appliances nearby, like a garbage disposal or dishwasher, to prevent electrical hazards. Use towels or a bucket to contain the water and prevent it from spreading. Once the immediate flow is stopped, you can begin to assess the source or call a professional.
acceptedAnswer.description: Immediately turn off the water supply to the sink or your home, disconnect nearby electrical appliances, and contain the water with towels or buckets.
